name: Ōdate (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ōdate city emblem in white: an outlined shield-like device crossed by a horizontal band.
history: Municipal flag of Ōdate, a city in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1954.

features.role: Ōdate city emblem — an outlined shield-like device crossed by a horizontal band
